canonical_run_selection_rule: For each calendar date, the canonical production run is the UNIQUE run_type='live' pipeline_runs row with n_candidates>0 on that date (structural, outcome-blind). Zero such rows = no daily-full live session that day (excluded). 2+ such rows = AMBIGUOUS, excluded per fail-closed policy rather than picked by any heuristic.

decision_ledger_db.consumed_from: scratchpad READ-ONLY copy of the live production decision ledger (sqlite); NOT included in this store (dynamic operational data, not a static research artifact) -- the exact rows this replay depends on are sealed below in canonical_run_manifest + candidate_rows + pipeline_run_metadata instead, so verification never requires DB access.

ohlcv_daily_close.consumed_from: local umbrella working copy RenQuant/data/ohlcv/<TICKER>/1d.parquet (READ-ONLY); only the exact (ticker, date) closes actually used are sealed below in ohlcv_closes -- verification never requires OHLCV file access.

strategy_config_repo.consumed_from: renquant-strategy-104 git history (READ-ONLY) -- resolves, per canonical run, the exact commit of configs/strategy_config.json active at that run's created_at timestamp; the resolved commit sha + file content sha256 are sealed per-run in pipeline_run_metadata.*.regime_sizing_config, so verification never requires a renquant-strategy-104 checkout, only trust in the git commit hash as a content-addressed pointer.

purpose: Offline one-share-floor ON-vs-OFF replay over the production decision ledger, testing whether RS-2's floor-rescue mechanism (renquant-pipeline task_selection.py SizeAndEmitTask A-3 branch) would have rescued whole-share-rounded-to-zero candidates in the 2026-06-01..2026-07-10 window. r1 (orchestrator PR#471) picked, per calendar date, the run with the MAXIMUM deployment_delta_usd among ALL pipeline_runs rows for that date (up to 36/day, mostly zero-candidate renquant105 intraday decisioning ticks with n_candidates=0) as 'the representative session', and counted the denominator from ALL distinct run_dates rather than the same population. Codex review (2026-07-11): this is outcome-selected (look-then-select) and denominator-mismatched, not auditable. r2 fixes this: pre-declares exactly one canonical run_id per date via a STRUCTURAL rule blind to outcome (the unique pipeline_runs row with n_candidates>0 that date -- the real daily-full candidate-scoring session, distinct from the zero-candidate intraday ticks), fails closed (excludes, does not guess) on any date with zero or 2+ such rows, and filters both numerator and denominator to that exact predeclared population. r3 (Codex re-review 2026-07-11): two more validity gaps fixed. (1) The canonical query never constrained run_type='live' -- a shadow/other candidate-scoring run could become the claimed production representative solely because n_candidates>0. Both the date-population and canonical-candidate queries now filter run_type='live' explicitly, sealed as a field on every canonical row (in this dataset all 915 pipeline_runs rows in the window are already run_type='live', so the corrected numbers are unchanged -- but the filter is now a real, checked constraint rather than an unstated assumption). (2) REGIME_CAP/RESERVE were a hardcoded table with no fingerprinted proof they were the operative pinned strategy-104 config. Each canonical run's regime_params.{max_position_pct,cash_reserve_pct} is now resolved from the EXACT renquant-strategy-104 git commit active at that run's created_at timestamp (commit sha + file content sha256 sealed alongside the extracted values -- see pipeline_run_metadata.*.regime_sizing_config); the pure compute function consumes those sealed per-run values, never a hand-copied table. (3) n_buys is now explicitly asserted ==0 for every canonical run before its rescue is counted -- the 'zero admission distortion' claim depends on this and previously went unchecked; a run with n_buys!=0 is now excluded (not silently assumed non-displacing) since this script does not reconstruct normal-buy cash state. All three checks pass cleanly on the current data (no dates newly excluded); the corrected numbers are unchanged from r2 (6/11 unambiguous canonical dates, $392.13-$1356.18/session, mean $911.13) -- but are now independently verifiable from sealed, fingerprinted inputs rather than an unverified table + an unstated filter.
